name: Coren Direbrew drops the CoA level-60 loot at live rates
contract: As on live CoA, Coren Direbrew rolls the six level-60 Brewfest trinkets at 1.667% each and Direbrew's Shanker and Tankard O' Terror at 5% each instead of a guaranteed stock level-80 trinket, so about 18% of kills yield a rare or better item.

steps.label: About 18% of Coren Direbrew kills yield a rare or better item, not every kill
